Ask about a consultation↗
Before your visit

A few useful
things to know.

How do I book?

Use the Book an appointment button to visit the current online booking system. Choose your service and an available time, then complete your booking there.

I’m not sure which service I need.

Get in touch before you book. Tell Pippin a little about your hair and what you’d like to achieve so she can help you choose.

Do I need a colour consultation or patch test?

Please check the requirements with Pippin before booking a colour service, especially if you’re a new client or changing products. She’ll confirm the right preparation and timing for your appointment.

Can I ask about hair loss privately?

Yes. Enquire about a mesh integration consultation to discuss the service, suitability and maintenance. You do not need to include personal medical information in the website enquiry.

Where can I see more of your work?

Visit The Snippity Pip on Instagram or Facebook using the links below for recent work and updates.
